**q25.**
CEL (Common Expression Language) engine in `internal/filter/` (core: `internal/filter/engine.go`). The engine compiles the CEL filter string to a dialect-agnostic IR condition tree (`internal/filter/parser.go` + `internal/filter/ir.go`), then a renderer (`internal/filter/render.go`) switches on dialect (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectPostgres`/`DialectMySQL`) to produce dialect-specific SQL fragments (e.g., `JSON_EXTRACT` vs `->>`; `LIKE` vs `ILIKE`), appended to the WHERE clause via `filter.AppendConditions` in each driver's `ListMemos`.

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo`, `memo_share` (via `ON DELETE CASCADE` FK at `LATEST.sql:109`). Comment memos are also recursively deleted, cascading the same tables for each.

**q27.**
mechanism: `go:embed` of Vite build output into the Go binary, served via Echo static middleware with SPA fallback
file: `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`

**q28.**
`s3presign.Runner` — `time.Ticker` every 12 hours (started in `server/server.go:166`)
Unused infrastructure: `internal/scheduler/` is a full cron-expression scheduler package that is never imported or used by any production code.

**q29.**
interceptor: `web/src/connect.ts` (ConnectRPC `authInterceptor`)
token kinds: JWT access token (15 min), JWT refresh token (30 days, HttpOnly cookie), personal access token (PAT, `memos_pat_` prefix)
backend validation package: `server/auth/`

**q30.**
`memos.memo.created`: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`
`memos.memo.updated`: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`
`memos.memo.deleted`: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`
`memos.memo.comment.created`: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`
Delivery convergence: all call `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`
